reference.isolates: a multi-block 3D grid (26 blocks, permuted interfaces, three blocks round some edges) on a transonic swept wing
sources: Lyu, Kenway and Martins, AIAA 2014-0567, Fig. 3 (ADflow, SA; read off the plot, +-0.5 count): CD at CL = 0.5 on these grids
Lyu, Kenway and Martins, AIAA J. 53(4) 968-985 (2015)
reference.notes: Per level, CD at CL = 0.5: 450,560 cells ~211 counts (this level), 3,604,480 ~202, 28,835,840 199.7, 230,686,720 ~199. This case runs at one estimated angle (2.2 deg), not at CL = 0.5, so CL and CD are compared loosely: near CL 0.5 the induced drag changes by about 1.5 counts per 0.01 of CL (CL^2 / (pi e AR), AR 8.3, e ~ 0.85). This code, 450k level, alpha 2.2 deg, van Albada, unbounded steps (Oct 24, A100, 2940 steps, 38 min): CL 0.502865, CD 0.022494 (friction 0.005899), CM -0.186073; about 224.5 counts at CL 0.5, +6.4% on the reference. The unlimited kappa = 1/3 scheme from freestream (no bound) diverged in 20 steps.
